description: This file is a React component named MCPToolsViewer that displays a user interface for browsing, selecting, and testing MCP tools. It manages fetching the list of available tools, displays the tools with UI states for loading and error, and integrates a test panel for each selected tool. The component handles user interactions, API calls, and state management related to MCP tools.

methods.name: MCPToolsViewer
methods.description: React functional component that renders the MCP tools list and testing interface, managing tool selection and invocation.
